cues: Gravimetric analysis weighs, volumetric analysis measures a volume.
Equivalent weight is molar mass over the n factor, and for an element, atomic weight over valency.
The n factor is basicity, acidity, total charge, or electrons transferred, which gives permanganate three different values.
Normality is molarity times n. Molality does not change with temperature.
Primary standards can be weighed directly, secondary ones cannot.
N one V one equals N two V two.
And permanganate is its own indicator, in dilute sulphuric acid only.
text: Let us recap. Gravimetric analysis weighs, volumetric analysis measures a volume. Equivalent weight is molar mass over the n factor, and for an element, atomic weight over valency. The n factor is basicity, acidity, total charge, or electrons transferred, which gives permanganate three different values. Normality is molarity times n. Molality does not change with temperature. Primary standards can be weighed directly, secondary ones cannot. N one V one equals N two V two. And permanganate is its own indicator, in dilute sulphuric acid only.
